hints.tr: Yazım: `CREATE VIEW dbo.ad AS SELECT ...;`. Görünüm bir sorguya verilen kalıcı bir ad; içindeki sorgu önceki bölümlerde yazdığın gruplama.
hints.en: The syntax: `CREATE VIEW dbo.name AS SELECT ...;`. A view is a lasting name given to a query; the query inside is the kind of grouping you wrote in earlier sections.

hints.tr: Üç tablo: `customers`, `orders` (iptal bilgisi), `order_items` (tutar). `GROUP BY c.id, c.name`. Hesaplanan sütuna ad vermek şart (`AS revenue`); yoksa görünüm kurulmuyor.
hints.en: Three tables: `customers`, `orders` (the cancelled flag), `order_items` (the amounts). `GROUP BY c.id, c.name`. Naming the calculated column is required (`AS revenue`); otherwise the view is not created.

hints.tr:
Sorgunun tamamı:

```sql
CREATE VIEW dbo.customer_revenue AS
SELECT c.id, c.name,
       SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price) AS revenue
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.id
WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled'
GROUP BY c.id, c.name;
```
hints.en:
The whole query:

```sql
CREATE VIEW dbo.customer_revenue AS
SELECT c.id, c.name,
       SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price) AS revenue
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.id
WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled'
GROUP BY c.id, c.name;
```

checks.query: SELECT id, name, revenue FROM dbo.customer_revenue ORDER BY id;
